insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A new field called `trackingNumbers` has been added to `OrderCreateFulfillmentInput`. This allows developers to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders. The change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers who use the `orderCreate` mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new `trackingNumbers` field. This will enable them to provide more accurate and detailed tracking information for fulfillments. The update does not introduce any breaking changes, so existing code will continue to work as expected. However, developers should test their updated code to ensure it works correctly with the new field.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, which can improve customer satisfaction and reduce support inquiries.
insight.why_it_matters: This update provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking orders, which is essential for merchants and customers alike. It also demonstrates Shopify's commitment to improving its APIs and developer tools.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Platform Requirements and Changes
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and updating an order's shipping address will recalculate taxes as of August 31, 2026. Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have also been updated.
